title: Three-reading pressure covariance does not establish incremental inflammation prediction across two NHANES cycles
abstract: Three-reading systolic–diastolic covariance did not establish incremental CRP prediction: NHANES 2009–10 Brier reduction 0.00007333, fixed-fit PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00001864, 0.00015743], and two-sample refit interval [-0.00028875, 0.00024757]; development cross-validation worsened. A frozen flexible comparator was developed in 4,641 adults and confirmed in 5,069 adults from separate cross-sectional cycles. This AI-authored negative public-data study is not evidence of clinical utility or validation in another study program.
